answer:
Going by your records, two medicines are still listed as active prescriptions:

1. Jardiance (empagliflozin) 10 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily in the morning, prescribed 20 February 2025.
2. Atorvastatin 20 mg tablet, one tablet by mouth once daily, prescribed 20 February 2025 for cholesterol.

Metformin 500 mg is marked as completed, with an end date of 15 April 2024, so it is not on your current list.

A prescription listed as active does not prove you still take it. The records do not show any stop for these two, but please confirm with your pharmacy or doctor. The records also do not include over-the-counter medicines, supplements, or anything another doctor prescribed.
